footer.tagline: Your place on earth, where time moves a little slower.

hero.title: Your Masurian hideaway
hero.subtitle: A minimalist lake house surrounded by forest.

amenities.title: Why Lagom Masuria
amenities.subtitle: Everything you need for deep rest, designed with attention to every detail.
amenities.jacuzziDesc: A private outdoor relaxation zone, perfect for unwinding under the stars in the evening.
amenities.forestDesc: Immerse yourself in the scent of pine forest. Our plot borders a protected nature reserve.
amenities.lakeDesc: Only 500m separates you from Garbas Lake, with a wild, scenic path down to the water.

interior.title: An interior full of light
interior.desc: Designed in harmony with the Lagom philosophy - neither too little nor too much. A spacious living room with fireplace, fully equipped kitchen, and forest-view bedrooms create a comfortable retreat for up to 6 guests.

house.title: About Our House
house.desc: Designed around the 'Lagom' philosophy - just right. Our house is a place where Scandinavian minimalism meets the warmth of the Masurian landscape. We offer space to breathe and slow down in the heart of nature in Stare Juchy.

pond.title: Panorama of the Masurian hills
pond.desc: Rolling countryside towards the village of Liski, with a private pond in the distance — the view that comes with your morning coffee on the terrace.

kayak.title: Kayaks & SUP
kayak.desc: Explore the calm waters of the surrounding lakes at your own pace. Equipment is available on site.

bike.title: Cycling trips
bike.desc: Hundreds of kilometres of forest paths and scenic trails around Stare Juchy.

fishing.title: Fishing
fishing.desc: Take the small rowing boat out at dawn for a quiet catch — available on site for our guests.

food.title: Local cuisine
food.desc: Discover regional flavours with our trusted local hosts.

garbas.title: Garbas Lake
garbas.desc: A wild, scenic path down to the water, tucked away in nature — a perfect walk for a summer morning.

gallery.title: Gallery
gallery.subtitle: Discover the harmony of nature and minimalist design. Our interiors and surroundings were created to give you space to truly breathe.

booking.title: Check Availability
booking.subtitle: Choose your dates and send a booking request for your stay in the heart of nature. We'll contact you to confirm the dates.
booking.datesSubtitle: Minimum stay is 2 nights. The estimated price updates automatically.
booking.summarySubtitle: Double-check your details before sending the request. You can still go back and edit them.
booking.confirmationMessage: We've received your booking request. We'll contact you by email or phone to confirm the dates and block them in the calendar.
booking.fillDetailsError: Fill in all required guest details
booking.unavailableError: Selected dates are unavailable. Please choose different dates.
